# Inventory: Create Transfer Lots

Area overview and notes: [inventory.md](../inventory.md)

`POST /transfer-lots/transactions/{transactionId}` · tenant-scoped token

Create Transfer Lots with user-entered cost bases for a transfer-in ("deposit") transaction.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `transactionId` | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 timestamp representing the date from which the user-entered cost basis information should be applied. If not provided, user-entered cost basis information is effective at time of deposit. |
| `transfer_lots` | array of object | Yes | List of transfer lots to be created for the transfer-in transaction. If any lots already exist the new lots replace them. |
| `transfer_lots[].quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Amount of the asset being transferred. |
| `transfer_lots[].cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Non-negative cost basis (value of the lot at acquisition). A negative value is rejected with a 400. |
| `transfer_lots[].acquisition_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lot was acquired. |

Example request body:

```json
{"effective_datetime":"2023-10-25T00:00:00.000Z","transfer_lots":[{"quantity":"0.5","cost_basis":"20000"},{"quantity":"0.5","cost_basis":"30000","acquisition_transaction_datetime":"2023-10-20T19:18:17.543Z"}]}
```

**Response 200**: Post Transfer Lot response

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | No |  |

**Errors:** 400 Validation Error response that can contain either a single error message or an array of error messages. · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
